***MEDIA ALERT***MEDIA ALERT***MEDIA ALERT***
Kate Upton and Justin Verlander Host
GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT
Thursday, March 31, 2016

Model and actress Kate Upton and Detroit Tigers Pitcher Justin Verlander partnered with Wins for Warriors and the Detroit Tigers to host the second annual GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT. The event took place before the first pitch at the Detroit Tigers vs. New York Yankees spring training game in Lakeland. The event benefitted SPCA Florida and K9s For Warriors.

Joined by some of Verlanders’ Detroit Tigers teammates, Upton helped in giving out the limited edition GRAND SLAM ADOPTION EVENT t-shirts, played with lovable adoptable dogs that were onsite via SPCA Florida, posed for pictures with them and met attendees who checked out the dogs – some of whom adopted them on site. Animal lovers, Upton and Verlander have adopted dogs of their own, and frequently visit shelters around the country.
The event was a huge success, as a majority of the SPCA’s dogs that were at the event have already been adopted.

“I am so grateful for the work that both SPCA Florida and K9s For Warriors accomplish. I want to encourage the adoption of these loveable animals who need homes, and also to honor the veterans who have given so much for our country," said Upton.

The event was co-hosted by Verlander’s Foundation, Wins For Warriors, and the Detroit Tigers. It was sponsored by BlackTie Digital Marketing, Pride Bites, Topgolf, Lazydays RV, Hall Communications, Delaware North, Paul Mitchell/Floyd’s Barbershop, Angel Gray Photography, David Dickey Jr. Photography, Pro Forma Denali Marketing, Gionis, Caulley & Dillenger, Dennis Hart, Dreams Come True Entertainment, Lakeland PD and Bounce House.
Hi-Res Event Photos:  https://www.dropbox.com/sh/syxb45dy5xls3gd/AAACw_exf7qiCUar2szDQplYa?dl=0
Photo Credit: Angel Gray
About SPCA Florida:

Founded in 1979, SPCA Florida is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization headquartered in Lakeland. Dedicated to improving the lives of pets and people in the community, SPCA Florida provides caring, compassion and hope to more than 6,000 homeless animals entering our doors each year. Open to the public, our McClurg Animal Medical Center is a state-of-the-art veterinary facility that heals and helps 50,000 patients annually. Thousands more pets and people are served through our community outreach and education programs. www.spcaflorida.org
About K9s for Warriors:

Founded in 2011, K9s for Warriors is dedicated to providing service canines to warriors suffering from post-traumatic stress and/or traumatic brain injury as a result of military service post 9/11. Our goal is to give a new leash on life to rescue dogs and military heroes, empowering warriors to return to civilian life with dignity and independence. www.k9sforwarriors.org.
About Wins for Warriors:

Wins for Warriors Foundation (started by Justin Verlander in August of 2013) helps advocate for and invest in resources that enable Veterans and their families to lead resilient lives. www.winsforwarriors.org
About Kate Upton:

Supermodel and actress Kate Upton quickly rose to international fame since her career began in 2008. One of the few models who is able to maintain a mainstream and high-end appeal, Upton has appeared in campaigns for Bobbi Brown, Express, Guess and Sam Edelman to name a few, and appeared on the cover of the world’s most prestigious magazines including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Harper’s Bazaar, V, CR Fashion Book and Love to Sports Illustrated, Cosmopolitan and Esquire. On the big screen Upton was most recently seen starring alongside Cameron Diaz and Leslie Mann in the hugely successful Fox comedy, “The Other Woman.”
About Justin Verlander:

Justin Verlander is in his eleventh full season at the Major League level as a right-handed pitcher with the Detroit Tigers. He was selected as the American League Most Valuable Player and was unanimously named the American League Cy Young Award winner in 2011, becoming the 10th pitcher in Major League history to win both awards in the same season.  Additionally, Verlander was selected as the American League Rookie of the Year in 2006, and he is only the second player in big league history to win the Most Valuable Player, Cy Young and Rookie of the Year awards.  A six-time All-Star with the Tigers, Verlander has tossed two no-hitters for the club (June 12, 2007 vs. Milwaukee and May 7, 2011 at Toronto).
